name: Device Frame Perspective Tilt Reveal
composition: High-fidelity browser window frame floating in 3D perspective space (`rotateX(15deg) scale(0.95)`).
focal_point: Browser frame leveling flat (`rotateX(0deg) scale(1.0)`) on scroll viewport entrance.
layout_behavior: Centered container in hero or project section with 3D perspective wrapper (`perspective: 1000px`).
typography_characteristics: Clean browser header bar with URL label (`app.domain.com`) in 12px mono.
choreography: Frame enters angled in 3D space. As user scrolls or section enters, frame rotates flat and shadow deepens.
perceived_physics: Heavy physical glass device settling smoothly onto a desk surface.
interaction_model: Scroll-linked transition or automatic section intersection reveal.
visual_hierarchy: Primary visual anchor of the hero section.
why_it_works: 3D rotation adds physical depth and tactile realism to flat web screenshots.
accessibility: Disable 3D tilt when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is active.
responsive: Flattens to 2D view (`rotateX(0)`) on small screens (<768px) to prevent clipping.
performance: Requires `will-change: transform` on outer wrapper. GPU accelerated.
web_implementation_strategy: Framer Motion `useScroll` with `useTransform` or CSS scroll-driven animation.
portfolio_applications: Featured project hero mockup showing live web app UI.
notes: Extracted from Jitter website and product presentation templates.

name: Floating Card Stack Spread
composition: 3 stacked UI cards overlapping at an angle spread outward into a clean 3-column row.
focal_point: Stacked cards fanning out smoothly on hover or scroll.
layout_behavior: Relative card container with absolute positioned overlapping children.
typography_characteristics: Card titles (16px bold) with subtitle metadata pills.
choreography: Card 1 shifts left (-150px, -5deg). Card 2 stays center (0px, 0deg). Card 3 shifts right (+150px, +5deg).
perceived_physics: Fanning out a deck of playing cards.
interaction_model: Hover on section or scroll trigger spreads cards; mouse leave restores stack.
visual_hierarchy: Center card rests on top; side cards rest slightly behind in stack state.
why_it_works: Demonstrates multiple application views or feature highlights in a single compact footprint.
accessibility: Ensure keyboard tab focus naturally cycles through cards in logical DOM order.
responsive: Converts directly to vertical stacked column layout on mobile screens.
web_implementation_strategy: Framer Motion layout variants with hover state trigger.
portfolio_applications: Showcasing desktop, tablet, and mobile views of a single project simultaneously.
notes: Extracted from Jitter showreel and portfolio presentation templates.
